metadata.proposal_title: Motion-Aware and Compute-Efficient Video Representation Learning with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures

checks.name: Project & Usage Alignment
checks.notes: vjepa2 is a PyTorch codebase for V-JEPA 2 self-supervised video pretraining, evaluation and action-conditioned world modelling. It is used for Objective O1: Develop motion-aware and computationally efficient JEPA-based video representation learning methods . Aligns with the approved topic.

checks.name: Project & Usage Alignment
checks.notes: The dataset contains approximately 650,000 human-annotated, ~10-second YouTube video clips across 700 human action classes, with CSV/JSON annotation files. It is required for Objective O2 — Conduct controlled pretraining experiments on Shaheen III on the trade-offs between motion understanding, representation generalization and computational efficiency, as specified in the proposal's datasets section. Aligns with the approved research topic, [topic name].
